Author: R. Mahadevan

 Dr.M.Sowmiya Sundari .. A
 Vs. 
 1.The State of Tamil Nadu  Represented by its Principal Secretary to Government  Health and Family Welfare Department  Secretariat, Fort St.George  Chennai  600 009  2.The Commissioner of Food Safety  O/o. The Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration  DMS Compound, Teynampet  Chennai  600 006 .. Respondents  Writ Appeal filed under Clause 15 of Letters Patent, against t  dated 21.09.2023 passed in W.P.No.18749 of 2022.
 For Appellant : Mr.G.Sankaran  Senior Counsel  for Mr.S.Nedunchezhiyan  For Respondents : Mrs.Sneha  Special Counsel https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/4  W.A.N Dr.M.Sowmiya Sundari vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 3 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139653643/
1  JUDGMENT (Judgment of the court was delivered by R. MAHADEVAN, J.) This Writ Appeal arises from the order dated 21.09.2023 passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P.No.18749 of 2022. 
2. Today, when the matter is taken up for consideration, the learned counsel appearing for the appellant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ appeal, with liberty to the appellant to approach the authorities. He has also made an endorsement in the case bundle to that effect. 
3. In view of the submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the appellant, this writ appeal is dismissed as withdrawn, granting liberty to the appellant to approach the authorities for any other relief. No costs. 
Connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
